## Summary
SoftwareWorld's side-by-side comparison of Infigo vs OnPrintShop. Direct page fetch returned thin shell; content reconstructed from search-engine summary. Useful as third-party signal on how the two are positioned head-to-head in software-directory listings, not as a deep technical comparison.

## Key takeaways
- **Positioning shorthand:**
  - Infigo: storefront + customer experience first, deepest editing tools (MegaEdit), strong for personalization/VDP.
  - OnPrintShop: 360-degree SaaS framing, broader marketing of "all-in-one" solution.
- **Feature coverage shorthand:**
  - Infigo covers: Workflow Management, Helpdesk Management, Engagement Management, Social Media Management.
  - OnPrintShop covers: Workflow Management, White Labeling, Direct Marketing, Products & Pricelist Management.
- **Editorial framing (notable):** "Infigo's core platform focuses more on the storefront and customer experience, with more editing tools compared to systems that are primarily MIS systems mixed in with web-to-print features." Same line shows up in WhatTheyThink and Capterra reviews — suggests Infigo's marketing successfully owns this positioning across the trade ecosystem.
- **Caveat:** Direct fetch returned empty body — likely heavy JS render. Use OnPrintShop's own competitive content (their blog regularly compares to Infigo) as a cross-check.
